marketLayer.title: HK Tech Stocks & AI Ecosystem
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index closed up 1.8% during the HK trading session, led by gains in cloud computing and semiconductor-related shares following positive enterprise AI adoption guidance.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerating enterprise spending on AI infrastructure across Greater China is underpinning a re-rating in top-tier HK tech giants, encouraging consistent Southbound capital inflows.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential expansion of global tech trade friction and domestic cloud price-war pressure impacting near-term profit margins.

marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap & Semiconductor Futures
marketLayer.fact: US equity futures advanced ahead of the New York open, supported by strong earnings reports from key semiconductor suppliers and stable US 10-year Treasury yields near 4.15%.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capital expenditure commitment by hyperscalers continues to shield the global semiconductor supply chain from broader macroeconomic headwinds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Elevated valuation multiples leave US technology equities vulnerable to any minor earnings misses or macro inflation shocks.

marketLayer.title: Mainland Property & HK Consumer Discretionary
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed mainland property developers traded mixed following local housing support updates, while consumer service and beverage equities saw modest gains on positive mid-summer mobility data.
marketLayer.inference: Market participation remains highly stock-specific, favoring cash-flow-resilient consumer service leaders over highly leveraged real estate names.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of broader domestic consumer sentiment recovery and effectiveness of ongoing housing inventory absorption policies.
